note: Weekly target = August monthly GA4 target x 7/30. Vesu remains excluded (still closed, no bookings or Google spend). The portfolio landed 952 bookings against a 949 target (+0.3 percent) and was up +13.3 percent year on year, though down 4.8 percent week on week off an exceptional prior week of 1,000. Three venues beat target, led by Cantina (+94%), Shiro (+22%) and The Chinese Library (+7%); Dim Sum Library (-18%), Aqua HK (-13%) and Hutong (-7%) came in below their August weekly targets. On a YTD basis only Aqua HK (-6.9%) and Dim Sum Library (-6.4%) still trail their cumulative targets; the other four remain comfortably ahead.
